title: Julian Romance (Syriac narrative of Julian the Apostate and Jovian); RU: «Сирийский роман о Юлиане Отступнике»
author: Anonymous (perhaps Edessene)
date: Between 363 and the 6th c. (oldest manuscript 6th c.)
edition: Hoffmann 1880, Syriac text (public domain); BL Add. 14641.
ru_evidence: ru.wiki «Сирийская литература» names the romance but gives no translation; absent from the vostlit index.
value: A major Syriac narrative and the Christian counter-image of Julian's Persian campaign; used by Tabari. Brockelmann's Lexicon cites it 1,117 times. Matters to Late Antique historians.
ai_feasibility: High (Syriac prose); good English versions are available for cross-checking.
pilot_unit: Part III (Persian expedition, Jovian), c. 20k words (estimate).
